labels.comments: timing category is borderline. Depends on how one interprets this sentence: "The RPD found that the Appellant's delay in claiming refugee protection indicated a lack of legitimate fear of persecution because the Appellant claims to have feared the authorities in Syria since 2011 yet traveled to the United States, Canada and Italy since 2011 without claiming asylum." He arrived most recently in 2016 and most likely claimed in 2016 -- but the other sentence suggests another visit to Canada. The most likely timeline for another visit to Canada at some point from 2011 on, would result in 1 year +. However, if the visit came at the end of the range, then it would not be. I went back and forth on this one a lot, but I think (c) is really the only viable option, even if I can understand why the model said (a).
